Poštovani,
S obzirom da je kao što znate u Crnoj Gori epidemija Kovid 19, u sklopu redovnog pregleda obično je potrebno obaviti i testiranje na Kovid. Iz istih  razloga je i gužva, preopterecenost svih zdravstvenih ustanova, veliki broj turista u Budvi, izostanak kontrole turista na granici pri ulasku u Crnu Goru. Složićete se da je to nešto na šta mi kao ordinacija ne možemo da utičemo. Dajemo sve od sebe da pacijenti dobiju pomoć kad im je potrebna . Testiranja u svrhu putovanja obavljaju se  u  odvojenom dijelu klinike, na prvom spratu.
S poštovanjem
Milmedika
Poštovani Igore, hvala Vam najljepše. Srdačan pozdrav od Milmedika tima.

Dear sir, we are very sorry for your experience and thank you for your suggestion. We are doing our best, but due to Covid pandemic, that efects medical staff as well, there are days when we are lacking staff. We will try to overcome these situations.
Wishing you all the best,
Milmedika team

Dear sir, Budva is overcroweded and there is no Public hospital, therefore there is a lot of people in need for medical assistance. We have daily hospital part within the clinic, so the nurses were busy with the patients who are very sick.These are the "unknown reasons". As you know there is a spread of Covid local transmision as well, so no one can expect the comfort that are used to.
We are very sorry for your bad experience. I hope that  you eventualy get the service that you nedeed.
Sincerely,
Milmedika

Thank you. Sorry for your waiting.
Milmedika

Poštovana, ne postoji tehnička usluga davanja infuzije u klinici. Da bi se dobila  infuziona ili bilo koja druga terapija  potrebno je da ljekar obavi pregled i procijeni da je odredjena tearlija neophodna.onog trenutka kada uđete u ordinaciju naši ljekari i i ostalo osoblje preuzimaju odgovornost za svaku ordiniranu terapiju. Ljekove ne prodajemo već ih pacijenti dobijaju u sklopu cijene pregleda.
Srdacno Vas pozdravljamo.
Milmedika

Dear Valued Patient,
​In accordance with the complaint you filed regarding the services provided by our institution, we formed an internal commission consisting of Dr Rade Kaluđerović (Medical Specialist), Anja Kaluđerović (Legal Counsel and Patient Rights Advocate), and Dr Dragan Pratljačić (Medical Specialist).
​Following your complaint, we requested a professional explanation from Dr Marija Mališić, which we hereby relay to you :
​"During the initial examination, the patient stated that the lesions had been present for a long time and had already been treated multiple times at other clinics; this information, along with the patient’s condition at that time, was noted in the medical report. It was explained that the lesions could be removed using cryotherapy. However, given the number, scope, and size of the lesions, as well as the history of previous treatments elsewhere, it was clarified that the procedure must be repeated every 5–7 days until complete removal is achieved. It is not possible to resolve such a case in a single treatment. Additionally, it was explained that the necessary agent could be purchased at a pharmacy for home application, provided the instructions are followed. The patient did not attend the scheduled follow-up examination."
​Commission Conclusion:
The commission has concluded that Dr. Marija Mališić acted in full accordance with the principles of good medical practice and the current guidelines of the European Academy of Dermatology and Venereology (EADV). We found no professional errors in this specific case.
​It is the standard practice of our institution to review all patient complaints involving clinical dilemmas through a consultative board, as was done in your case. Regarding the billing, the procedure fee was €100, rather than the €150 mentioned in your complaint. Furthermore, any subsequent follow-up examinations or interventions required to resolve the issue would have been free of charge.
​We sincerely regret that we did not meet your expectations, as patient satisfaction is, and will remain, our primary mission. Guided by this policy, we have become recognized as the private healthcare institution with the longest tradition in Montenegro (30 years), and we are proud recipients of the Montenegrin Medical Chamber Award for the best private healthcare institution in the country.
​Once again, we are sorry that your experience was not satisfactory. We hope this will not be the case in the future and invite you to remain our patient now that you are more familiar with our clinical protocols. We trust that we have resolved your concerns and remain at your disposal for any further clarification.
​Best regards,
​Management of PZUMilmedika

Uvažena Gospodjo Marina,

Obraćan Vam se povodom neprijatnosti koju ste doživjeli u našoj poliklinici. U terminu koji ste Vi bili zakazani, Doktorica je imala hitnu operaciju, a nakon intervencije je pozvan pacijent koji je tada bio zakazan. Nažalost u medicini se dešavaju hitna stanja, ali nas to ne opravdava što ste čekali i nije ispoštovan redosled zakazivanja. 

Glavna sestra A3 Medical Poliklinika,Radmila Ostojić
Thank you so much for your kind and heartfelt words. We are truly grateful for your trust. Dr. Zindovic and our entire team wish you good health and send warm regards to you all. 💚 …
